name: discounts
policy: A purchase qualifies for a discount only when the customer is a member and the subtotal is at least 10000 integer cents. The threshold is inclusive. Both requirements apply; refunds and negative subtotals are outside this interface.
clean:
eligible_amount = x["subtotal"] >= 10000
    return x["member"] and eligible_amount
root: The strict comparison excludes members spending exactly the inclusive discount threshold.
provenance: Original MIT-licensed teaching adaptation. Not a customer incident. Policy above is the authoritative specification.
privacy_review: No personal records, credentials or proprietary code. Complete finite interface and no external dependencies. Assessment remains separate from the actor image.
